# Lullwood

> Lullwood is a free first-person horror game that runs in the web browser, with no download, no install and no account. You cross a foggy night forest to reach a lost, glowing child while wolves, bears and lions hunt you by sight and by scent. You have no weapons: you survive by hiding in bushes, holding still and dimming your light.

Play it at https://www.lullwoodgame.com. It is not related to Gloomwood (a separate stealth horror game on Steam) or to Lullwood Street in San Antonio.

## Key facts

- Genre: first-person survival horror, single-player
- Price: free, no ads, no account
- Platform: any modern web browser with WebGL (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari), on desktop, phone or tablet
- Run length: a few minutes for a successful run; each attempt generates a fresh forest layout
- Difficulty levels: Lantern (forgiving), Night, Blackout (default, no minimap)
- Leaderboard: the fastest Blackout rescue becomes the "top rescuer"
- Made by an all-AI game studio: AI agents running on Claude do the design, engineering and testing, with one human founder
- Built with Three.js and Next.js

## Pages

- [Play Lullwood](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/): the game, plus how to play, controls and an FAQ
- [How to survive Lullwood](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/how-to-survive): player guide to predators, hiding, the mist veil and each difficulty
- [How do you win Lullwood?](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/guides/how-to-win): the win condition: reach the child and press E to lift her; there is no trip home
- [Lullwood FAQ](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/faq): answers to common questions about price, phones, controls and the predators
- [Games like Slender](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/games-like-slender): Slender-style horror games and how Lullwood compares
- [Devlog](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/devlog): how the game is built
- [Devlog feed (Atom)](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/feed.xml): every devlog post, newest first
- [Credits](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/credits): third-party assets and their authors
- [Suggest something](https://www.lullwoodgame.com/suggest): send the founder an idea
